images.title: Count only exact matches
images.purpose: Show that equal parts do not always give lines of symmetry: the ring has 6 lines, the looped design 4, the twisted flower none.
images.composition: Three designs in one row with wide gaps, a count below each.
images.exact_structure: One row of exactly 3 designs of equal size. Design 1: a spiky ring with 6 equal spikes, teal #0072B2, with 6 thin grey #6B7280 lines through the centre. Design 2: a twisted flower with 6 petals each curling the same way, amber #E69F00, with no lines. Design 3: a looped design with a small square in the centre, teal, with 4 thin grey lines (upright, across, 2 diagonals). A count text below each design. Exactly 3 designs.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any fold line drawn on the twisted flower
images.takeaway: Count a fold line only when the halves overlap exactly.
images.description: Three designs in a row: a spiky ring with 6 fold lines, a twisted six-petal flower with none, and a looped design with a square centre and 4 fold lines.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to fold each design in their mind and say how many folds make the halves overlap.

image_decisions.why: The idea is a picture idea; one clean image carries it.
